claims.claim: Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera With 70-300mm Lens
claims.evidence: Photos show a Nikon DSLR and a 70-300mm-style zoom lens, but the exact D3400 model text and the full 70-300mm marking are not clearly readable in the provided images.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No photo/video of the camera powering on, taking a shot, autofocus test, shutter count, or any functional checks.

risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (not actually D3400) or different lens variant than claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model name/label (e.g., on the body/under the battery door) and a close-up photo of the lens name/markings showing the full focal length (70-300mm) and lens model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Nikon DSLR with an unknown/uncertain lens variant (worst-case vs claimed bundle).

risks.risk: Lens or camera faults (focus issues, shutter/mirror problems, sensor dust, lens fungus/haze).
risks.proof: Video or photos of: camera powering on, live view, autofocus on a high-contrast target, and a sample photo; plus a close-up of the lens front element and rear element for haze/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst-case: needs service / unreliable).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card) or incomplete kit.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (battery, charger, both lens caps, strap, USB/AV cables if any, and SD card if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as body + lens only (worst-case missing charger/caps).

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage or heavy wear affecting resale value (scratches, dents, worn mount).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the camera body corners, lens mount area, and lens exterior (front/back) under good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with visible wear (worst-case).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera model identifier (D3400) from the body/label area.
Clear close-up photo of the lens markings showing the exact lens model and that it is 70-300mm.
Video showing the camera powering on, autofocus working, and taking at least 2 sample photos.
Photos of lens front and rear elements for haze/fungus; plus a shot of the sensor (or a test image showing dust).
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, SD card if any).
response.reason: The photos confirm a Nikon DSLR with a telephoto zoom lens, but the exact D3400 model and the exact 70-300mm lens variant are not clearly readable, and there is no functional proof that it is working perfectly or that the kit is complete. To price safely, request the decisive identification and working-test proof.
